situations.title: 알레르기력·노출원 문진
situations.tagline: I broke out in hives after lunch — I'm not sure what caused it.
situations.brief: 음식·약물·벌 등 노출원과 알레르기력을 체계적으로 문진하세요.
keyPhrases: What did you eat, take, or come into contact with before the hives started?
Have you ever had a reaction like this before?
Any trouble breathing or tightness in your throat right now?

situations.title: 경증 두드러기 사정
situations.tagline: The rash is just on my arms — should I be worried?
situations.brief: 국한 여부와 진행 가능성을 사정하고 경과 관찰을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Right now it looks limited to your arms, which is reassuring.
We'll watch to make sure it doesn't spread or affect your breathing.
Let me know immediately if your lips or tongue start to tingle.

situations.title: 항히스타민 투여 설명
situations.tagline: Will this shot make me sleepy? I have to drive home later.
situations.brief: 항히스타민의 작용과 졸림 등 경과를 알기 쉽게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: This antihistamine will calm the itching and the hives.
It can make you drowsy, so you shouldn't drive for a while.
We'll keep you here a bit to make sure you don't react again.

situations.title: 약물 알레르기 이력 확인
situations.tagline: I think I'm allergic to penicillin but I'm not totally sure.
situations.brief: 약물 알레르기 이력을 밴드·기록과 대조해 정확히 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you describe what happened when you took penicillin?
Was it a rash, swelling, or trouble breathing?
I'll put a red allergy band on you and flag it in your chart.

situations.title: 에피펜 사용법 교육
situations.tagline: My doctor gave me this pen but I'm scared I'll use it wrong.
situations.brief: 에피펜 자가주사법과 재발 시 대처를 단계별로 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: Pull off the blue cap, then press the orange tip firmly into your outer thigh.
Hold it for three seconds, then call 911 even if you feel better.
Can you show me on the trainer how you'd do it?
goals: 사용 후 응급실 재방문의 필요성을 설명한다

situations.title: 전형 아나필락시스
situations.tagline: My lips are swelling and my throat feels like it's closing up.
situations.brief: 기도·순환 침범을 확인하고 에피네프린 근주를 우선 시행·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm giving you a shot of epinephrine in your thigh now.
Does your throat feel tight or is it hard to breathe?
What did you eat or take right before this started?

situations.title: 조영제 반응
situations.tagline: I feel flushed and itchy all over — something's wrong.
situations.brief: 조영제 주입을 즉시 중단하고 반응을 사정·대응하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm stopping the contrast right now.
Tell me if your throat feels tight or your breathing changes.
We're moving you where we can watch you closely and treat this.

situations.title: 항생제 IV 중 반응
situations.tagline: You just started that IV antibiotic and now my chest feels tight.
situations.brief: 주입을 중단하고 활력 급변에 대비하며 에피네프린을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm stopping the antibiotic and flushing your line now.
Are you feeling any swelling in your face or trouble swallowing?
I have epinephrine ready in case we need it.

situations.title: 벌쏘임 전신반응
situations.tagline: I got stung an hour ago and now I feel dizzy and my whole body itches.
situations.brief: 전신반응의 진행을 감시하고 에피네프린 반복 필요성을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The dizziness with itching tells me this is a whole-body reaction.
We may need to repeat the epinephrine if symptoms keep progressing.
Have you ever been stung and reacted like this before?

situations.title: 음식(견과) 아나필락시스
situations.tagline: There must have been peanuts in that — my face is swelling fast.
situations.brief: 원인 성분과 재노출 위험을 확인하고 에피네프린을 우선 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm giving epinephrine now for this reaction.
Did the food have peanuts or tree nuts that you know of?
After this we'll talk about how to avoid it and carry an EpiPen.

situations.title: 이상성 반응 관찰
situations.tagline: I felt better an hour ago but now the tightness is coming back.
situations.brief: 호전 후 재악화 가능성을 설명하고 재발 징후를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Sometimes symptoms come back hours later — that's why we kept you here.
Tell me the moment your throat or breathing changes again.
We may repeat treatment, so stay in bed and keep your monitor on.

situations.title: 베타차단제 복용자
situations.tagline: I take a beta blocker for my heart — the epi doesn't seem to be helping much.
situations.brief: 에피 저반응 가능성을 인지하고 글루카곤 투여를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Because of your heart medication, the epinephrine may work less well.
We're giving glucagon to help your body respond.
What's the name of your beta blocker and when did you last take it?

situations.title: 임산부 아나필락시스
situations.tagline: I'm 30 weeks pregnant and I can't breathe — please help my baby.
situations.brief: 좌측위와 태아 안녕을 고려하며 에피네프린을 지체 없이 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm giving epinephrine now — it's safe and it helps both of you.
I'm tilting you onto your left side to help blood flow to your baby.
We're monitoring your baby's heartbeat the whole time.

situations.title: 라텍스 알레르기
situations.tagline: I'm allergic to latex — please don't use those gloves near me.
situations.brief: 라텍스를 환경에서 제거하고 교차반응 물질을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: We're switching to latex-free gloves and supplies right away.
Do certain foods like bananas or avocado also bother you?
I'll flag your latex allergy so everyone caring for you knows.

situations.title: 소아 아나필락시스 보호자
situations.tagline: His face is swelling up — he's only five, please do something!
situations.brief: 체중 기반 용량을 확인하며 불안한 보호자에게 처치를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm giving him epinephrine dosed for his weight right now.
You're doing great — keeping him calm helps a lot.
What did he eat, and how much does he weigh?

situations.title: 후두부종 기도폐쇄 임박
situations.tagline: I can't… get air…
situations.brief: 조기 기도확보를 준비하며 이비인후과 호출과 에피 지속을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Your airway is swelling — we're securing it before it closes.
I'm continuing epinephrine and calling ENT to the bedside.
Stay as calm as you can and breathe slowly with me.
goals: 임박한 기도폐쇄를 인지하고 조기 기도확보를 준비한다

situations.title: 아나필락시스 쇼크 불응
situations.tagline: I'm so dizzy… everything's going gray…
situations.brief: 에피네프린 지속 주입과 대량 수액을 시행하며 불응성 쇼크에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Your pressure is very low, so we're starting an epinephrine drip.
We're pouring in fluids to bring your blood pressure up.
Stay with me — squeeze my hand if you can hear me.

situations.title: 심정지 진행 아나필락시스
situations.tagline: He's got no pulse — this is anaphylactic arrest.
situations.brief: 소생술과 에피네프린을 병행하며 팀 리더로서 지휘하세요.
keyPhrases: Start compressions — this is anaphylactic arrest.
Give epinephrine and hang a liter wide open.
Airway is swollen, so get the difficult airway cart now.

situations.title: 이상성 반응 재악화
situations.tagline: It's happening again — the swelling and wheezing are back, worse this time.
situations.brief: 재악화를 인지하고 재투여를 시행하며 감시를 강화하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a second wave — I'm giving epinephrine again now.
We're keeping you on the monitor and staying right here.
Tell me exactly how your breathing feels compared to before.

situations.title: 다중 알레르겐 중환자
situations.tagline: I react to so many things — I don't even know what set this off this time.
situations.brief: 원인을 규명하고 유발원을 격리하며 중증 반응을 안정화하세요.
keyPhrases: We're removing anything you might be reacting to from your room.
Let's list everything you've eaten, touched, or taken today.
I'm treating the reaction now while we figure out the trigger.

situations.title: 관찰 중 급변 야간 SBAR
situations.tagline: Obs patient's vitals just took a turn overnight — need to hand off.
situations.brief: 야간 활력 추이를 정리해 담당 의료진에게 SBAR로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Post-anaphylaxis obs patient, stable until zero-two-hundred.
Blood pressure dropped to ninety over fifty and hives returned.
I gave a second epi and I need you to reassess him now.
